result.title: Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators
result.summary: Single-site heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) degrades sharply under real-world motion. Multi-site PPG provides a natural solution, but existing models fuse sites as generic sensor channels rather than exploiting their hemodynamic structure: each heartbeat propagates along the arterial tree, appearing across body sites as delayed and transformed copies of the same cardiac event. We propose the Cross-Site Transformer, which introduces a hemodynamically informed inductive bias by restricting multi-sensor fusion to cross-attention between PPG sites. On WildPPG, the largest in-the-wild benchmark available, our model establishes a new single-model state of the art, reducing error by 21% over the previous best and 35% over the best prior transformer. The same cross-site restriction makes the trained network directly auditable. Because each cross-attention head lies on one directed pathway between sites, causal resample ablation can isolate and test each direction of information flow. Ablating the chest-to-wrist pathway doubles error, whereas the reverse costs far less. Encoding hemodynamic structure into attention routing thus improves real-world sensing robustness and enables rigorous auditing of multi-sensor fusion.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Cross-Site Transformer，依据心跳沿动脉树传播的延迟与变换结构，把多部位 PPG 的融合限制为站点之间的 cross-attention，在 WildPPG 上降低心率估计误差，并可沿有向路径做重采样消融来审计信息流。
AI.relevance_reason: 把融合限定为结构化的跨源注意力路径、再按路径方向做消融归因，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据与 latent 状态的选择性注入、以及各证据流的贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；但任务与信号模态相距较远，需较多核查。
